messages.content: cek apakah stok untuk ukuran L dan M sudah di bawah ambang minimum dan perlu diisi kembali?

function.name: inventory_restock_check
function.description: Checks the inventory levels for specified items and determines if restocking is required based on minimum threshold levels. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

item_ids.description: A list of unique integer identifiers for items to check in the inventory.

threshold.description: The minimum inventory level before restocking is triggered.

include_discontinued.description: Whether to include discontinued items in the restock check.

message.content: Untuk memeriksa tingkat persediaan secara akurat, saya memerlukan ID unik dari barang yang dimaksud (misalnya produk tertentu dalam ukuran L dan M). Bisakah Anda memberikan daftar `item_id` yang sesuai dengan ukuran L dan M tersebut? Setelah itu, saya dapat menjalankan fungsi pemeriksaan restock.
message.reasoning: The user asks: "cek apakah stok untuk ukuran L dan M sudah di bawah ambang minimum dan perlu diisi kembali?" They want to check inventory for sizes L and M. We need item IDs for those sizes. But we don't have them. We can ask clarifying question: which item IDs correspond to sizes L and M? Or maybe they refer to product sizes. We need to clarify.
